import bpy,json,collections
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_stone_20261115';c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
rows=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH':continue
 if not(any(t in o.name for t in ['coping','dock wall','parapet','terrace core','stair','M14 working','M14 bearing']) or (o.data.materials and any(t in o.data.materials[0].name for t in ['SageLeaf','SaltBush']))):continue
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 rows.append({'name':o.name,'min':[round(min(p[i] for p in pts),3) for i in range(3)],'max':[round(max(p[i] for p in pts),3) for i in range(3)],'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials],'modifiers':[(m.name,m.type,getattr(m,'width',None)) for m in o.modifiers]})
(cap/'source_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
plants=[r for r in rows if any(t in str(r['materials']) for t in ['SageLeaf','SaltBush'])]
stone=[r for r in rows if r not in plants]
print(json.dumps({'stone_count':len(stone),'stone':stone[:28],'plant_count':len(plants),'plant_samples':plants[:3]},ensure_ascii=False))
